architectural-decision-records.why: records the auto-sync nudge decision, its boundary split, and its limits
architectural-decision-records.what: wrote ADR 0054: a SessionStart-only nudge when the install is behind, pure logic in sync-nudge.mjs and I/O in emit-directive, loud then capped then reset, conservative when unsure
quotes: Every architecturally significant change ships with an ADR in the same unit of work

verifiable-quality-gates.why: the nudge ships discriminating tests that go red if it stops nudging or starts nudging wrongly
verifiable-quality-gates.what: added test/sync-nudge.test.mjs (behind nudges + counts, in-sync/ahead clear, new target resets, cap falls back, no-marker/unparseable say nothing) and test/emit-directive-nudge.test.mjs (behind injects, subagent does not, in-sync clears)
quotes: replace each check with a no-op and require its test to fail

comprehensive-test-strategy.why: the change adds logic and an I/O boundary, so both levels are tested
comprehensive-test-strategy.what: unit tests for the pure decision module and an integration test that runs the real emitter against a fake home; registered both in the explicit test list
quotes: Fast, isolated tests for logic; a smaller number of integration tests for the seams

bdd-comprehensive-testing.why: coupling fires on the added code; the behavior is pinned as scenarios
bdd-comprehensive-testing.what: implements the loud-then-capped-then-reset nudge on SessionStart with discriminating scenarios for behind, in-sync, subagent, and no-marker
quotes: These are not optional and not left to judgment. Every time this

owasp-secure-coding-bdd.why: the emitter now reads markers and writes a counter file in the user home
owasp-secure-coding-bdd.what: the nudge text is static (no external input interpolated unsafely), the file I/O is best-effort inside try/catch so it never breaks the directive, and existing control-character stripping still applies to the injected text
quotes: For the change in front of you, look up the matching sheet in the catalog below

skeptical-audit.why: the ADR states what the nudge does NOT do rather than overclaiming
skeptical-audit.what: documented that the nudge compares versions only, not a full --check, that the emitter output now depends on ambient home state, and the best-effort counter caveat
quotes: content hash, a query, a version/commit SHA, or a URL + retrieval date;

judge-arch.why: reviewed in fresh context before the PR
judge-arch.what: ran a fresh-context judge-arch over the pure module, the emitter boundary change, the tests, and the ADR before opening the PR
quotes: These are not optional and not left to discretion. Every review does all

release-deployment-safety.why: a session-start convenience; nothing deployed, migrated, or released

enterprise-architecture-standards.why: dev tooling; no system, data, or resilience architecture change

pattern-selector.why: no design pattern selected; a guard plus a counter

sre-operational-readiness.why: no service, SLI/SLO, or alerting change

compliance-data-lifecycle.why: no personal data; the counter is a local non-personal integer

arch-encode.why: a feature, not a rule encoded from a newly-caught mistake

universal-accessibility-wcag.why: agent-facing injected text, not a user-facing UI

usability-ux-universal-design.why: agent-facing injected text, not a user-facing UI
